name: Applaud — notes to NAS (NFS) and Obsidian vault

assignments.name: summarize_prompt
assignments.value: Summarize the following meeting/voice-memo transcript in 3–5 concise bullet points, then end with a one-sentence takeaway. Use markdown.

nodes.name: Make folders
nodes.notes: Write File to Disk doesn't create missing folders (the FTP node did). Creates this recording's YYYY/MM and Summary/images in Europe/London time, matching Rewrite URLs. Needs NODES_EXCLUDE=[] on n8n 2.x.

parameters.command:
=set -eu
src=$(printf '%s' '{{ $json.sourceB64 }}' | base64 -d)
dst=$(printf '%s' '{{ $json.vaultB64 }}' | base64 -d)
dir=$(dirname "$dst")
mkdir -p "$dir"
# Build the vault version under a dot-name first: Obsidian ignores dot files, so
# it never sees a half-written note.
tmp="$dir/.applaud-$$.tmp"
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
if [ '{{ $json.relinkImages ? 1 : 0 }}' = 1 ]; then
  sed 's#(<Summary/images/#(<images/#g' "$src" > "$tmp"
else
  cp "$src" "$tmp"
fi
if [ ! -e "$dst" ]; then
  mv "$tmp" "$dst"
  echo "written: $dst"
elif cmp -s "$tmp" "$dst"; then
  echo "unchanged: $dst"
else
  name=$(basename "$dst")
  stem="${name%.*}"
  ext="${name##*.}"
  new="$dir/$stem-$(TZ=Europe/London date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).$ext"
  [ -e "$new" ] && new="$dir/$stem-$(TZ=Europe/London date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)-$$.$ext"
  mv "$tmp" "$new"
  echo "kept existing, wrote copy: $new"
fi

nodes.name: Copy to Vault
nodes.notes: Copies each file just written to the NAS into the Obsidian vault (Config → vault_root). New file: written. Same content: left alone. Different content: existing note kept, new version saved with a -YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS suffix.
